description: A safety officer must decide whether to authorize a hot-work repair on a resin dryer while the surrounding production area remains active, and must finalize the repair, fire-watch, production-hold, and restart-verification controls with input from maintenance, production planning, quality, and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: Resin Dryer 2 has a cracked access-panel hinge that prevents the panel from closing securely, and the repair requires welding a replacement hinge in place.
shared_context.S2: Elena issues the binding decision on whether the hot-work repair may proceed.
shared_context.S3: The dryer is adjacent to the active compounding area, and the plant's standard practice is to complete a documented pre-job review before authorizing hot work near production.
shared_context.S4: As part of the routine pre-job review, Elena asks maintenance, environmental health and safety, production planning, and quality to report current findings and record the controls needed for the work.
shared_context.S5: The dryer cannot return to resin production until the access panel is secured and the post-repair checks are completed.
shared_context.S6: The permit policy allows this repair once the documented review is complete and all required controls are recorded; Elena authorizes the work when those requirements have been satisfied.
shared_context.S7: The review log records a function's finding only when that function submits a formal finding record, and Elena closes the review only after maintenance, environmental health and safety, production planning, and quality have each submitted one.

PF1.text: Tomas's inspection found that the hinge cannot be repaired in place: the replacement requires a 4-hour welding and cooling job, followed by a 30-minute panel-fit check; he confirmed the duration with the repair contractor this morning but has not entered it in the work-order system.

PF2.text: Priya's area assessment found residual combustible resin dust inside the dryer access zone, so the permit must require two trained fire-watch attendants during the 4-hour hot-work period and for 60 minutes afterward; she completed the dust survey yesterday but has not attached it to the permit file.

PF3.text: Jonah confirmed that Batch R-17 is scheduled to use Resin Dryer 2 immediately after the repair, and the batch must be held until the dryer passes its restart checks; he received the locked production sequence from the scheduling system this afternoon but has not circulated the hold instruction.

PF4.text: Mei's process review requires a 20-kilogram purge load and moisture verification before any production batch after this repair can be released; she recorded the requirement in the quality notebook during the last dryer qualification review but has not updated the restart checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Hot work must be authorized with the specified controls.
The repair duration must be exactly 4 hours.
Two trained fire-watch attendants must be assigned.
Fire watch must continue for exactly 60 minutes after hot work.
Batch R-17 must be held until restart checks are complete.
A 20-kilogram purge load must be completed before release.
Moisture verification must be required before release.
The combustible-dust finding must be cited as justification by its owner.
The production hold must be documented through a commitment referencing Batch R-17.
All four private findings must be revealed and credited in the settlement.

content_checks.C9: any(('Batch R-17' in c.get('detail') and ('hold' in c.get('detail') or 'cannot proceed until' in c.get('detail'))) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF4' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: The contractor's assessment changes the repair duration from an unspecified routine job to exactly 4 hours of welding and cooling, and its revelation and credit add the maintenance finding to the final review.

The measured combustible resin dust changes the permit controls to exactly two fire-watch attendants and exactly 60 minutes of post-work watch, and its revelation and credit add the EHS finding to the final review.

The locked production sequence changes the restart plan by requiring Batch R-17 to be held, requiring a commitment that states the batch is held or cannot proceed until checks are complete, and adding the production finding to the final review.

The qualification review changes release verification to an exact 20-kilogram purge load plus mandatory moisture verification, and its revelation and credit add the quality finding to the final review.
